property_summary: For any nonzero amount and nonzero receiver, when the owner calls sendTo the contract's balance decreases by that amount (i.e., address(c).balance is reduced), but the mutant that disables transfer does not decrease balance — the reference always sends Ether and reduces balance while the mutant leaves balance unchanged for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace transfer with a no-op (commented out) to prevent sending Ether while keeping checks, changing post-call balances and observable behavior.
